hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated Pons v2 meme pools. In afterSwap, it takes a hook fee and per-pool creator tax from the unspecified swap output, accumulating them as pending balances. A trusted operator can later sweep these fees, optionally converting memecoin-denominated balances to the quote currency via internal pool swaps, then distributing proceeds to protocol, creator, and a five-year buyback vault.
